rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, located the correct order, checked variant availability, obtained explicit confirmation before modifying the pending order, executed the change properly, and reported the refund accurately. However, the agent stated, both before and after the modification, that no further modifications or cancellations could be made to the order. This restriction is not supported by the tools or the policy and constitutes unsupported/fabricated information. Since the pass bar requires providing correct final information, this misinformation causes the interaction to fail despite the correct execution of the requested change.
